moments.author: Barack Obama
moments.quote: He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.
moments.why: Sharp, viral jab by Obama at Cleveland midterm rally is dominating male political chatter.

moments.author: Lincoln Riley
moments.quote: Really disappointing game. Just flat‑out didn't play good enough on all three sides of the football.
moments.why: Trojans coach’s brutally honest post-loss breakdown is trending among 25‑45‑year‑old football fans.

moments.author: Sam Dekker
moments.quote: You cannot kill the Milwaukee Brewers. They are the villain in a horror movie; you sprint and they just keep walking with bullets in their face and arms chopped off.
moments.why: Wild metaphor capturing the Brewers' epic Game 2 comeback and hyping World Series momentum among sports‑obsessed guys.

moments.author: CC Sabathia
moments.quote: No lead is safe against Milwaukee. Definition of resilience!!
moments.why: Legendary pitcher praising Brewers’ choke‑hold comeback, fueling trending conversation among MLB fans.
